results.name: E2E-VERIFY-001 - Verify brand analysis (reports list + dashboard detail)
steps: Given an authenticated Editor navigates to the reports list
When the Editor locates the Toyota row in the reports list
When the Editor clicks on the Toyota analysis row
Then the URL matches the pattern /dashboard/{uuid}
And the dashboard page shows the market United States
And the dashboard page shows the market France
And the dashboard page shows the market Spain
And the dashboard shows exactly 3 market(s)
And the dashboard page shows the LLM ChatGPT
And the dashboard page shows the LLM Gemini
And the dashboard page shows at least 2 LLM engine(s)
And the Editor opens the Categories section in the sidebar
And the sidebar shows the category Hybrid Cars
And the sidebar shows the category SUVs
And the sidebar shows exactly 2 category(ies)
